about: R3-EARTH-LINK EL3 (K1, design r3/earth-link.md): the comms station's copy. A line is a list of parts: a string is copy, a [field, format] pair is one earth.* sim field, formatted and nothing more (D-21; ui/comms_panel.gd CommsPanel.format). Times read as the HUD's Earth clock (comms_clock: +4.31 yr). {i} in a field is the Exchange log row's message index. rate_bands are tried in order: the first whose min <= earth.rate (and earth.rate < max, when max is given) gives the Earth-rate phrase.
